english.note: Use this when the female hostess is the owner or person running an inn, guesthouse, or other establishment.

examples.english: The hostess at that inn was very friendly and even carried our luggage herself.
examples.traditional: 嗰間客棧嘅老闆娘好好人，仲親自幫我哋拎行李。
